description: An Irish company's filing/submission history (annual returns, accounts, charges, etc.) by CRO number, from the CRO's (Companies Registration Office) own live Open Services API. This data is not in the CRO's open-data snapshot, only in its live, access-controlled API; Pipeworx supplies a CRO Open Services credential, so no key is needed. Optional: use your own CRO Open Services account by passing your registered email as _apiKey and the API key as _apiSecret (or both as _apiKey "email:key"). Use company_bus_ind 'B' for a registered business name rather than a company.

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own CRO Open Services account email (or "email:key"). Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

_apiSecret.description: Optional: the CRO Open Services API key issued to that account.

company_bus_ind.description: 'C' for a company (default), 'B' for a registered business name.

name: ie_get_filings
title: Ie Get Filings
